title: console: the Keyboard Shortcuts dialog advertises N, ⌘/Ctrl+E, ⌘/Ctrl+/, ⌘/Ctrl+D and B, and none of them does anything
body:
Path: ② the capabilities an end user meets in the app — console chrome | 缺项 | P2

Split by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` from objectui#11672 (the 2026-10-06 console dogfood sweep, showcase, framework `ce577ec4`), item 1. Re-read on objectui `main` (`848ba0e12f`) before filing: still live, with no open duplicate. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/app-shell/src/chrome/KeyboardShortcutsDialog.tsx` (the static list, about `:40`–`:71`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: the dialog is a hard-coded list that no handler backs.

## What happens

On `/apps/showcase_app/showcase_task`, with focus on the page body, `N`, `⌘/Ctrl+E` (also on a record page), `⌘/Ctrl+/` and `⌘/Ctrl+D` change nothing, and `B` does nothing: only `Ctrl+B` toggles the sidebar (`packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx` about `:120`–`:124`). `⌘K` and `?` work. `useCrudShortcuts` / `useKeyboardShortcuts` (`packages/react/src/hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts.ts`) has no caller.

## Done when

- The dialog lists exactly the shortcuts that are wired. It is derived from the registered handlers or kept beside them, never a separate static list.
- Whether to wire the missing ones is not this card's question. A shortcut appears in the dialog only once its handler exists.
- **Pin:** every shortcut the dialog lists has a handler that fires in a test.
